long_biography.plain_text:
Sea service ran through Ković's family, but he formalised it with a degree from the Faculty of Maritime Studies in Split and work aboard Princess Cruises and P&O Cruises. In 2006 he acquired his first charter vessel, beginning more than a decade as its owner-captain and establishing a repeat-client charter business.

Ković subsequently commissioned a larger Croatian motor-sailer and stayed at the helm rather than separating ownership from daily service. He directs routes, equipment and the guest experience, and he personally selected the crew. His operating model treats chartering as bespoke hospitality: itineraries respond to whether guests prefer privacy, conversation, quiet anchorages or lively evenings. Crew continuity is another priority; several staff have worked together for years, and return bookings are a defining feature of the business.
